_about: Site settings read by /shape/shape.js. support.url: paste a Stripe Payment Link, Buy Me a Coffee or Ko-fi link to switch the Support buttons on. ads.showHouse: show 'Your Chicago business here' cards in empty ad spots. ads.sponsors: one entry per paid ad; slots = where it shows (home, news, learn, tracker, budget, pensions, wards, lot); it stops on its own after 'until'.
